tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background — the concourse. Every page sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills for ghost controls; raised rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary button, inputs). Meets 3:1 on surface-000 and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, labels and captions on surface-000/100 (≥6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: solari-yellow
tokens.usage: The signal colour: primary button fill, the yellow flap, one highlighted row. Never body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solari-yellow (11:1).

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Yellow words and small marks on page surfaces — links, active nav, eyebrow labels. Use this, not solari-yellow, for text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px.

tokens.name: housing
tokens.usage: The board's metal housing. Same in both themes: a board is a physical object.

tokens.name: flap
tokens.usage: Face of every flap, top and bottom half.

tokens.name: flap-split
tokens.usage: The hairline gap across the middle of a flap, and the hinge shadow.

tokens.name: flap-ink
tokens.usage: Characters on a flap (14:1 on flap).

tokens.name: flap-yellow
tokens.usage: Characters on a flap that must stand out: the headline message, a delayed time (10:1 on flap).

tokens.name: flap-alert
tokens.usage: Face of an alert status flap (CANCELLED). Always carries white flap-ink text and a word; never used alone.

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Column headers and captions set directly on housing (7:1).

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: flap-display
styles.usage: Characters on a large flap; the SplitFlap sets size from its cell height. Use directly only where a board can't go.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Every message, one flap at a time.
styles.usage: Page title under or beside the hero board. One per page.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A website that reads like the board above the concourse.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero, in ink-muted, max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Short sentences. Present tense. Say where, say when.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links; between a status flap and its neighbour.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons; between stacked boards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a panel's label, title and body; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutters; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between hero rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-flap
tokens.usage: Flap corners — just enough to read as a moulded plastic card.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels and board housings: sheet-metal corners.

flap.note: Cell heights for a fixed-size SplitFlap. Cell width is 0.66 × height.

tokens.name: flap-sm
tokens.usage: Nav wordmark, departures rows on phones, inline tags.

tokens.name: flap-md
tokens.usage: Departures rows, section boards, clocks.

tokens.name: flap-lg
tokens.usage: Fixed hero boards (use fit for full-width heroes).
